name: Stilton
siboNotes: Aged blue cheeses like Stilton are naturally low in lactose due to the aging process. Generally well-tolerated in SIBO diets when consumed in moderate portions.
preparationTips: Bring to room temperature before serving to enhance flavor
Crumble over salads or pair with low-FODMAP crackers
Store wrapped in wax paper rather than plastic to maintain texture
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in calcium for bone health
Contains beneficial probiotics from aging process
